title: From Swath to Full-Disc: Advancing Precipitation Retrieval with Multimodal Knowledge Expansion

problem.claim: Accurate full-disc precipitation retrieval is needed beyond the scanning swath, but infrared-based algorithms have low accuracy because their relation to surface precipitation is weak.

gap.claim: More accurate passive microwave and radar-based methods are limited in range, leaving a need for accurate infrared-based full-disc retrieval.

contributions.claim: A two-stage Multimodal Knowledge Expansion pipeline with the PRE-Net model is introduced for precipitation retrieval expansion.

The Swath-Distilling stage transfers multimodal knowledge to an infrared-based model using Coordinated Masking and Wavelet Enhancement, while the Full-Disc Adaptation stage uses Self-MaskTune to balance multimodal and full-disc infrared knowledge.
A PRE benchmark is introduced for evaluating precipitation retrieval expansion.

author_reported_evidence.claim: Experiments on the introduced PRE benchmark reportedly show that PRE-Net significantly improves precipitation retrieval performance.
PRE-Net reportedly outperforms PERSIANN-CCS, PDIR, and IMERG.

narrative_sequence.summary: Satellite technologies have enhanced near-real-time precipitation retrieval, but existing modalities have complementary limitations.
Infrared methods have low accuracy, while passive microwave and radar methods have limited range.
The paper proposes a two-stage multimodal knowledge expansion pipeline with PRE-Net, including swath distillation and full-disc adaptation.
Experiments on the PRE benchmark reportedly show improved performance over leading products.

source_observation.claim: The method transfers knowledge from multimodal data within a reliable scanning swath before adapting predictions across the full disc.

interpretation.claim: A staged transfer strategy can separate knowledge distillation from broader-domain adaptation.

application.claim: For tasks requiring wide spatial coverage from weaker observations, first distill knowledge in a trusted coverage region, then adapt to the larger domain.

exception.claim: The abstract does not establish whether this staged strategy generalizes beyond precipitation retrieval or other sensing configurations.

unknowns: The abstract does not report quantitative benchmark results or evaluation conditions.
The abstract does not specify the data sources, model architecture details, or scope of the PRE benchmark.
Code availability is stated but not independently verified.
